program.section_heading: Automotive Powertrain Specialist - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS990/AS990C/CE990
outcomes: Demonstrate personal and shop safety procedures neededto safely work in an automotive shop environment.
Utilize common shop equipment to diagnose and repairtrans missions and related control systems.
Demonstrate the ability to perform industry standardre build procedures.
Identify root cause of common engine failures
Demonstrate ability to utilize precision measuringequipment required to properly rebuild engines and transmissions.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the single Program Requirements list (24 units) and the Program Learning Outcomes are shared by both awards and are recorded here for the certificate.
The section heading is printed three times; the third version reads 'AS990/AS990B/AS990C/CE990' instead of 'AS990/AS990C/CE990'.
Every required course is marked '( Historical )' in the catalog; a reviewer should confirm these courses are still active for the 2026-2027 catalog year.

Catalog prints codes with hyphens (AUT-1A, etc.); these match the closed-list codes AUT 1A, AUT 1B, AUT 2, AUT 3, AUT 6A, AUT 50. The catalog titles AUT-50 'Automotive Principles' while the closed list reads 'Automotive Principle'.
Outcomes are copied as printed, including run-together and split words ('neededto', 'repairtrans missions', 'standardre build', 'measuringequipment').
